_source: Derived from routePolicy() in src/index.js (Chakudya API). Not part of the OpenAPI spec on purpose - this describes runtime policy (rate limits, role gates), not shape.

rules.note: Not rate-limited or auth-gated - served before the router's policy gate.

Caps how many batches (i.e. total fan-out) one IP can trigger per minute - each sub-request still pays its own cost against its own resource's own rate-limit bucket, so batching cannot bypass per-resource auth or limits.

Bulk-removes every chunk matching a citation string - needed before re-ingesting a document whose chunks were extracted badly, since /rag/ingest only ever inserts.
Most expensive route in the API - intent detection + fan-out search + rerank + LLM answer. Whole answers cached 5 min (skipped when session_id is passed).
